project_terms: CoCivium-specific hybrid civilization maturity model, NOT Kardashev energy scale
main_claim: Current evidence supports public R&D spark and bounded synthetic/host tests, not mature Civ2+ adoption or a Civ3+ transition.

definitions.civ1: Human-centric institutions and siloed computing, with high manual coordination
definitions.early_civ2: Consent-based source-aware human and AI cooperation, with local-first agency and real feedback
definitions.mature_civ2: Independently useful and maintainable, multi-provider, multi-custodian, plural governance with explicit exit, accountability, ecological cost and correction
definitions.candidate_civ3_boundary: Safe coexistence and cooperation across radically different participants, meaning systems, embodiments and time horizons without coercion, loss of rights or abandoned outsiders
alternate_historic_scenarios: High-dimensional CoObjects and translation across incompatible schemas
Verified external intelligence contact with paced safety review
definitions.hard_requirement: Voluntary participation, dissent, source/provenance, accountable power, rollback, recovery and protection for decliners

gaps.accept: 5 consenting independent first-use completions and two voluntary returns with failures documented
Exact current host content from two independent reader clients, accessible task navigation and correct domain routing
Real permission/revocation/deletion/bystander tests on actual adapters
Threat model, no-secret release, signed provenance, incident/rollback drill
Different custodian restores public-safe capsule on non-GitHub infrastructure without origin provider
Same authorized real task across local/open and hosted models, with source/effect/quality/cost/latency evidence
Two independent consumers roundtrip versioned relations with translation loss and disagreement tracked
Independent source/usability correction reproduced, fixed and voluntarily rechecked
Non-originator can govern release/stop, recover rights, maintain source, resolve dissent and safely rotate access
Verified reuse rights, third-party notices, licensed scopes, sustainable operating costs and fair access
Independent multilingual/accessibility/low-connectivity first-use outcomes and equivalent exit
Measured energy/latency/cost/physical safety and ecological externalities on matched tasks
Independently run nodes/institutions exchange, disagree, recover and honor scoped authority across legal boundaries
Adversarial scenario tests for voluntary refusal, cross-schema translation, no-crown review, safe return and independent proof
